GRADE 1 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 32 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Healing of of Jesus Christ at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Healing of of Jesus Christ using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Healing of of Jesus Christ completely.
   C. Healing of of Jesus Christ is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing of of Jesus Christ.

2. About Healing of of Jesus Christ at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Healing of of Jesus Christ at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Healing of of Jesus Christ completely.
   C. Healing of of Jesus Christ is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing of of Jesus Christ.

3. About Healing of of Jesus Christ when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Healing of of Jesus Christ helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Healing of of Jesus Christ completely.
   C. Healing of of Jesus Christ is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing of of Jesus Christ.

5. About Sharing values at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. appreciate the importance of keeping the clean environment clean by collecting litter
   B. Learners should ignore Sharing values completely.
   C. Sharing values is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Sharing values.

6. About Sharing values at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. appreciate the importance of keeping the clean environment clean by collecting litter
   B. Learners should ignore Sharing values completely.
   C. Sharing values is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Sharing values.

7. About Sharing values when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. appreciate the importance of keeping the clean environment clean by collecting litter
   B. Learners should ignore Sharing values completely.
   C. Sharing values is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Sharing values.

9. About Obedience values at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Obedience values using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Obedience values completely.
   C. Obedience values is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Obedience values.

10. About Obedience values at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Obedience values at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Obedience values completely.
   C. Obedience values is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Obedience values.

11. About Obedience values when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Obedience values helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Obedience values completely.
   C. Obedience values is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Obedience values.

13. About Church as a By the end of the Sub strand at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Church as a By the end of the Sub strand using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Church as a By the end of the Sub strand completely.
   C. Church as a By the end of the Sub strand is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Church as a By the end of the Sub strand.

14. About Church as a By the end of the Sub strand at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Church as a By the end of the Sub strand at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Church as a By the end of the Sub strand completely.
   C. Church as a By the end of the Sub strand is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Church as a By the end of the Sub strand.

15. About Church as a By the end of the Sub strand when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Church as a By the end of the Sub strand helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Church as a By the end of the Sub strand completely.
   C. Church as a By the end of the Sub strand is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Church as a By the end of the Sub strand.
